description_en: Queries the QPS information and cache hit count for a specified domain name
description_zh: 查询指定域名的QPS次数信息以及缓存命中次数
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-qps-with-cache --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --resource-group-id xx --domain www.example.com --start-time 1577794536 --end-time 1577796336 --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainQpsWithCache

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. The system automatically obtains this value. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

If you do not specify this parameter, the domain name in the first domain name configuration record is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名。

不指定该参数，则默认查询第一个域名配置记录的域名
parameters.name: domain
